text:
nina: quick sync — drafting relnotes for tomorrow's docs push. Need a concise BEFORE/AFTER for embeddings + a short FAQ entry about kv-cache interaction.
ash: do we still have streaming examples scattered in sdk/js and sdk/python?
nina: yes, two spots in sdk/js/embeddings.md and one in guides/migrations/embed-streaming.md. Also a stray absolute link to marketplace.vendor.com that 404s.
ash: I'll sweep the repo for streamCreate/stream_create and replace with the non-stream pattern + helper. Will open a PR.
peter: for the changelog, let's keep bullets short and include a one-line callout for Adaptive Routing: "new policy -> will prefer cost-tier stable models; can be disabled per-route."
nina: add Known issue: "Adaptive routing may prefer beta variants causing unexpected latency spikes for some Dedicated configs." recommend pinning model for Dedicated customers.
nash: drafting the JS/py snippets with clear BEFORE/AFTER markers. will include a tiny helper that matches typical user code.
nash: sample JS I'll add:
```js
// BEFORE: streaming-based pattern
for await (const chunk of client.embeddings.streamCreate({ model: 'embed-v1', input })) { process(chunk) }
// AFTER: sync helper + explicit non-stream flag
async function embedSync(client, model, input) { return await client.embeddings.create({ model, input, stream: false }) }
const vec = await embedSync(client, 'embed-v1', text)
```

nina: good. also add a one-line FAQ: "When switching off streaming, token accounting may increase per-request; consider batching or prefix caching (see Optimize -> batching)."
peter: I found and replaced the marketplace absolute link — switched to docs.redwood.ai/vendor-integration. Also fixed two broken anchors in the migration doc.
docs-bot: PR created: #5522 by ash - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5522
nina: CI flake on snippet playground sometimes; include unit tests that run the helper so we catch format errors.
ash: added tests and adjusted sample output expectation. CI running.
peter: one more thing: add a short example diff in changelog (one-line code sample) because folks only skim bullets otherwise.
nina: yep — will include a tiny "Code diff" box in the relnotes. If CI green I'll merge and ship. Tagging to close after merge.
